---

## 1. Company Overview & Engineering Philosophy

SOLVIXBIT operates at the intersection of enterprise software craftsmanship and modern applied artificial intelligence. We believe that off-the-shelf software and bloated legacy systems create operational friction that limits business growth. Our mission is to build robust, maintainable, sub-second technology assets that solve real commercial problems.

### Core Tenets
1. Zero Technical Debt Craftsmanship: Strict TypeScript typing, modular domain boundaries, automated testing pipelines, and clean architecture patterns (e.g. Hexagonal, Clean Architecture, Strangler Fig).
2. Sub-Second Global Performance: Edge-rendered Next.js applications, server-side data fetching, CDN caching, and database query optimization delivering <120ms p95 latencies worldwide.
3. Deterministic Applied AI: Practical, high-ROI AI workflows and RAG pipelines that automate manual processes with strict validation, privacy guardrails, and zero training on proprietary client data.
4. Transparent Engagement: Direct access to senior solutions architects and engineering leads, weekly staging demos, and complete IP ownership transferred upon project delivery.

## 2. Core Engineering Services

### 2.1 Custom Software Development
- Canonical URL: https://www.solvixbit.com/services/software-development
- Headline: High-performance software built for durability, security, and exponential scale.
- Overview: We architect and engineer bespoke software systems, high-throughput REST and GraphQL APIs, and custom enterprise web portals engineered from day one for sub-second performance.
- Tech Stack: TypeScript, Next.js 15, Node.js, Go, PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker, AWS ECS.
- Key Capabilities: Cloud-native web applications, microservices, distributed APIs, database architecture and query tuning, legacy system modernization.
- Deliverables: Full-stack architecture, OpenAPI specs, automated CI/CD pipelines, unit/integration test suites, zero-downtime deployment runbooks.

### 2.2 AI & Workflow Automation
- Canonical URL: https://www.solvixbit.com/services/ai-automation
- Headline: Autonomous agent workflows and LLM integrations that eliminate operational drag.
- Overview: Integrating intelligent AI agents, custom retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, and business process automation directly into core tools, saving 1,200+ manual hours monthly.
- Tech Stack: Python, LangChain, OpenAI API, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, Pinecone, FastAPI, n8n, Zapier Enterprise.
- Key Capabilities: Custom RAG and semantic search over corporate wikis/contracts, multi-step autonomous workflow agents, automated document extraction, intelligent customer support copilots.
- Privacy Guarantee: Zero data retention policies, local and private VPC inference options, strict model governance guardrails.

### 2.3 SaaS & Digital Product Engineering
- Canonical URL: https://www.solvixbit.com/services/saas-development
- Headline: Multi-tenant platforms engineered for rapid scale, high retention, and recurring revenue.
- Overview: Transforming software concepts into commercial SaaS applications with multi-tenant data isolation, Stripe/Paddle subscription billing, granular RBAC, and real-time usage metering.
- Tech Stack: Next.js App Router, Node.js, PostgreSQL with Row-Level Security (RLS), Stripe Billing, Tailwind CSS, Redis.
- Key Capabilities: Multi-tenant tenant-isolated databases, automated subscription lifecycle management, self-serve onboarding funnels, in-app product analytics.

### 2.4 Headless Web & Modern Ecommerce
- Canonical URL: https://www.solvixbit.com/services/web-ecommerce
- Headline: Composable ecommerce architectures delivering sub-second page loads and higher checkout conversion.
- Overview: Decoupled storefronts utilizing Next.js Commerce connected to Shopify Plus, Medusa, BigCommerce, or custom commerce backends for maximum conversion rate optimization.
- Tech Stack: Next.js 15, Shopify Storefront API, GraphQL, Sanity CMS, Algolia, Stripe Elements, Cloudflare Workers.
- Key Capabilities: Sub-second headless storefronts, multi-currency internationalization, custom checkout extensions, high-volume inventory sync.

### 2.5 Connected Systems & API Integration
- Canonical URL: https://www.solvixbit.com/services/api-integrations
- Headline: Unified middleware connecting fragmented enterprise tools, ERPs, CRMs, and payment gateways.
- Overview: Eliminating data silos by engineering resilient integration pipelines between Salesforce, HubSpot, SAP, NetSuite, Stripe, QuickBooks, and internal databases.
- Tech Stack: Go, Node.js, Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, Redis Streams, Webhooks, AWS EventBridge.
- Key Capabilities: Bidirectional CRM/ERP sync, event-driven webhook processing, automated schema validation, dead-letter queue (DLQ) retry systems.

### 2.6 Cloud & Infrastructure Engineering
- Canonical URL: https://www.solvixbit.com/services/cloud-integrations
- Headline: Highly available, auto-scaling cloud architectures built on AWS and modern container runtimes.
- Overview: Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), Kubernetes cluster orchestration, serverless microservices, and continuous deployment workflows with 99.99% uptime SLAs.
- Tech Stack: AWS (ECS, EKS, RDS, S3, CloudFront), Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, Datadog.
- Key Capabilities: Cloud cost optimization, zero-downtime blue/green deployments, automated disaster recovery, 24/7 observability and alerting.

### 2.7 Data Intelligence & Decision Systems
- Canonical URL: https://www.solvixbit.com/services/data-analytics
- Headline: Centralized analytics pipelines and interactive business intelligence dashboards.
- Overview: Designing data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, ClickHouse) and automated ETL/ELT pipelines to give business leaders real-time visibility into metrics and unit economics.
- Tech Stack: ClickHouse, PostgreSQL, Apache Airflow, dbt, BigQuery, Metabase, Python.
- Key Capabilities: Centralized analytics data modeling, automated ETL pipelines, real-time KPI streaming, churn and forecasting algorithms.

### 2.8 Application Security & Quality Engineering
- Canonical URL: https://www.solvixbit.com/services/security-quality
- Headline: Enterprise-grade application hardening, automated security testing, and compliance readiness.
- Overview: Protecting mission-critical software assets against cyber threats, data breaches, and vulnerabilities through comprehensive security audits, penetration testing, and SOC 2 readiness.
- Tech Stack: SonarQube, OWASP ZAP, Snyk, Playwright, Jest, HashiCorp Vault.
- Key Capabilities: Automated SAST/DAST pipeline integration, SOC 2 compliance readiness, end-to-end regression testing, zero-trust network policies.

### 2.9 Mobile & Cross-Platform Engineering
- Canonical URL: https://www.solvixbit.com/services/mobile-engineering
- Headline: High-performance iOS and Android mobile applications built for fluid user interaction.
- Overview: Cross-platform mobile engineering utilizing React Native and Flutter with native device bridge integration, offline storage, and instantaneous push notifications.
- Tech Stack: React Native, Expo, Flutter, TypeScript, Swift, Kotlin, Firebase, SQLite.
- Key Capabilities: Cross-platform code sharing (85%+ shared codebase), offline-first data caching, native biometrics authentication, background sync.

## 4. Case Studies & Proven Results

### 4.1 Fintech Real-Time Payment Engine
- URL: https://www.solvixbit.com/work/fintech-payment-engine
- Client: Global Fintech Platform
- Problem: Legacy settlement pipeline suffered from 2.4-second processing delays, transaction dropouts during traffic spikes, and lack of audit logging.
- Solution: Engineered an event-driven payment processing engine with Go, Redis Streams, PostgreSQL, and AWS ECS.
- Results: Sub-120ms settlement time, $42M+ monthly volume processed, 99.999% uptime, 0 lost transactions.

### 4.2 Headless Global Ecommerce Scale
- URL: https://www.solvixbit.com/work/ecommerce-headless-scale
- Client: International Direct-to-Consumer Luxury Brand
- Problem: Monolithic theme architecture was sluggish on mobile, causing 58% cart abandonment and high bounce rates across international markets.
- Solution: Rebuilt the storefront using Next.js 15 App Router, Shopify Storefront GraphQL, Sanity CMS, and global Edge CDN caching.
- Results: 68% faster page load (0.8s LCP), 34% increase in mobile conversion, 41% higher average order value (AOV).

### 4.3 Enterprise AI Copilot & Knowledge System
- URL: https://www.solvixbit.com/work/enterprise-ai-copilot
- Client: Enterprise Operations Firm (450+ staff)
- Problem: Support engineers spent 4+ hours daily manually looking up technical documentation, policy manuals, and past tickets across 6 disconnected tools.
- Solution: Built a private, RAG-grounded operations copilot with semantic search, role-based document access, and automated ticketing draft actions.
- Results: 58% reduction in Tier-1 tickets, 1,400+ employee hours saved monthly, 94% positive internal user satisfaction.

## 6. How to Engage SOLVIXBIT

1. Discovery Consultation: Submit your scope, wireframes, or problem statement at https://www.solvixbit.com/start-a-project or email hello@solvixbit.com.
2. Architecture & Proposal: Our partners conduct an initial technical discovery session, produce a preliminary architecture diagram, and deliver a transparent fixed-price or sprint-based proposal.
3. Rapid Sprint Execution: Agile two-week development sprints with continuous staging deployments, automated testing, and direct Slack/Teams collaboration.
4. Production Handover: Zero-downtime cutover, complete documentation, video walk-throughs, and warranty maintenance support.
